project_type: Next.js 14 App Router prop trading platform (ApexFunded)
test_framework: vitest (no tests currently exist beyond lib/risk.test.ts)
verification_instructions: Run `npx next build` to ensure zero build errors. All pages must compile as static or dynamic without errors.
setup_instructions: npm install, then npx next build
environment_constraints: Node 22 available. No .env file present but .env.example exists. Build works without env vars (demo mode). No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: Keep the dark luxury theme (bg-deep #02030a, gold, royal purple, emerald, rose accents). Use framer-motion for animations. Use lucide-react icons. Follow 'use client' directive pattern for client components. Use @/ path alias.
key_patterns: Components in app/components/. Dashboard uses DashboardLayout wrapper with Sidebar. Client components use 'use client' directive. Glass morphism via .glass/.glass-strong classes. Custom color tokens: bg-deep, bg-soft, bg-card, gold, royal, emerald2, rose2. Gradients: gradient-text, lux-text, royal-text, btn-primary, btn-secondary. Layout animations with framer-motion. All pages are single-file with inline sub-components.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js app router pages and components. app/components/ - shared UI. app/api/ - API routes. app/dashboard/ - user dashboard. app/admin/ - admin panel. lib/ - server utilities (db, plans, risk, mt5). tailwind.config.ts - theme config with custom colors/animations.
